citations.assessment: The baraita names Pappos ben Yehudah. It gives no identification or chronology for an Elazar ben Pappos.
The checked midrash relates the same exegesis with Elazar ben Pinchas. Lowy’s apparatus reports ben Pappos in Theodor–Albeck. The edition itself is still to be collated.

Status and the identification of the name remain open. Berakhot names Pappos ben Yehudah only. Lowy reports the Theodor–Albeck ben Pappos variant at Genesis Rabbah 37:8; the checked digital text has ben Pinchas.
